title: Comets and shooting stars
examples: What is the difference between a comet and a shooting star?
Why do shooting stars look bright?

explain.say: A comet is a big space object. It is often called a dirty snowball.
When a comet gets close to the sun, it heats up. This heat makes it leave a long tail.
Shooting stars are actually bits of space rock burning up. They are called meteors.

draw.text: Meteors burn up in Earth's air.

explain.say: The burning up part is what makes the bright light. This light is what we see as a shooting star.
In real life, we see these bright streaks at night. They are amazing sights to look for.
A common mistake is thinking all bright streaks are comets. They are not always the same thing.

items: Meteors are small bits burning up.
Shooting stars are the light we see.

faq.a: No, they are not actual stars. They are space rocks burning up as they enter Earth's air.
asks: What is the light from a shooting star?

faq.q: What makes a comet have a tail?
faq.a: The comet's icy materials turn into gas when they get hot from the sun. This gas forms the tail.
Comets are only easily seen when they get close enough to the sun to glow brightly. They move through space slowly.
asks: Can we see comets all the time?
How close must a comet be to shine?

faq.q: Is a meteoroid the same as a meteor?
faq.a: No, a meteoroid is the small rock in space. It only becomes a meteor when it enters Earth's atmosphere.
asks: What is the difference between meteoroid and meteor?
When does a space rock become a meteor?

faq.q: Can I predict when a comet will appear?
faq.a: Scientists can predict when comets might be visible, but it is hard to say for sure. Their paths are very long.
asks: Do we know when comets come?

facts: Comets are often described as dirty snowballs.
The tail of a comet is made of gas and dust.
A meteoroid is a small rock floating in space.
When a meteoroid enters Earth's air, it burns up, creating a meteor.

quiz.say: What is the bright streak of light we see at night?
quiz.show: Shooting star is a bright streak.
quiz.why: A meteor is the name for the light caused by burning space rock.

wrong.0: Stars are giant balls of gas that make their own light, which is different.
wrong.2: Comets are much larger objects that have tails, but they are not the quick streak.
wrong.3: A meteoroid is the rock before it enters the air; it is not the light itself.

quiz.say: What causes a comet to develop a tail?
quiz.show: Heat from the sun creates the tail.
quiz.why: The sun's heat causes the ice to vaporize into gas, forming the tail.

wrong.0: Collisions can break comets, but the tail is formed by sublimation.
wrong.2: Gravity keeps the comet together; it does not create the gas tail.
wrong.3: Planets can affect comets, but the sun's heat is the direct cause of the tail.

quiz.say: If a space rock enters Earth's atmosphere, what is it called?
quiz.show: Rock entering atmosphere is a meteor.
quiz.why: The visible streak of light when a space rock burns up is called a meteor.

wrong.0: Meteoroid is the name of the rock while it is still out in space.
wrong.1: A comet is a different type of icy body, not just a rock.
wrong.2: Space dust is too general; meteor is the specific term for the burning event.
